articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin sinks below $83,000 as Iran talks stall and oil climbs
articles.snippet: ZEC led losses among major tokens as Brent pushed toward $108 and traders added to bets on another Fed rate increase ahead of this week's inflation and jobs data.

articles.title: Hong Kong regulators expand financial reporting oversight to licensed crypto firms
articles.snippet: The SFC and AFRC signed a new MoU extending financial reporting, audit and compliance cooperation to licensed virtual asset service providers.

articles.title: Scammers steal $2M in ETH as fake GIWA network fools DYORSWAP
articles.snippet: DYORSWAP said it paid more than 200 ETH in compensation, while Upbit operator Dunamu’s GIWA warned that its mainnet had not launched.

articles.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
articles.snippet: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.

articles.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
articles.snippet: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.
